definition.origin: Foot contact plane under the centre of the published envelope
definition.handedness: Left and right follow Barco: stand behind the projector and face the screen. The right side is -X.

projector.lens_system: TLD+ interchangeable lenses; the body ships without a lens
projector.published_brightness: Published ratings differ by measurement convention and document. Read the current specification sheet.

definition.geometry: Published outer envelope with face-level layout from Barco documents. Sizes and positions of parts on each face are approximate or assumed. Not CAD.
definition.behavior: Inspection only. No simulated operation, optical result or hardware control.

components.label: Projector body
components.purpose: Housing for the light source, sealed optical engine, cooling and electronics.
components.action: Lift and place with enough people for a 48 kg unit. Keep every air inlet and the rear outlet clear.
components.basis: Envelope 540 x 725 x 339 mm and 48 kg are published. Panel lines and edge shapes are styling.

components.label: Lens holder
components.purpose: Carries a TLD+ lens and moves it for lens shift.
components.action: Fit or remove a lens only as the installation manual describes. Shift range depends on the lens.
components.basis: Front face is published. Horizontal centring is assumed. Height uses the 223 mm installation-manual figure.

components.label: Front air inlet
components.purpose: One of three filtered cooling air inlets.
components.action: Keep clear. Clean or replace the dust filter on the schedule in the user guide.
components.basis: An inlet on the front is published. Its size and its place on the face are assumed.

components.label: Top air inlet
components.purpose: One of three filtered cooling air inlets.
components.action: Keep clear; do not stack anything on it. Clean or replace the dust filter on schedule.
components.basis: An inlet on the top is published. Its size and its place on the face are assumed.

components.label: Right-side air inlet
components.purpose: One of three filtered cooling air inlets.
components.action: Keep clear when dressing cables from the input and communication module on the same side.
components.basis: An inlet on the right side is published. Its size and its place on the face are assumed.

components.label: Rear air outlet
components.purpose: The single exhaust for warm air.
components.action: Leave free space behind the projector. Do not let exhaust feed another unit's inlet.
components.basis: A single outlet at the rear is published. Its size and its place on the face are assumed.

components.label: Mains power input
components.purpose: Mains supply and the disconnect point for the projector.
components.action: Published ratings: 200 to 240 V at 13.5 A, or 120 to 160 V at 18.5 A with reduced light output. Confirm against the unit nameplate.
components.basis: The rear location is published through the rear IR receiver description. Connector type is not asserted.

components.label: Front IR receiver
components.purpose: Receives the remote control from in front of the projector.
components.action: Point the remote toward this window, or reflect it off the screen.
components.basis: Published as on the front, below the lens holder.

components.label: Rear IR receiver
components.purpose: Receives the remote control from behind the projector.
components.action: Point the remote toward this window when working behind the unit.
components.basis: Published as at the rear, beside the power input.

components.label: Adjustable feet
components.purpose: Level the projector on a surface. Rigging hardware attaches at the same points.
components.action: Adjust until a test pattern is level and rectangular. Use only Barco-approved rigging at these points.
components.basis: Adjustable feet that double as rigging points are published. Four feet at the corners is assumed.

components.label: LCD panel
components.purpose: Shows menus and adjustments, and status such as projector state, network address, active source and firmware version.
components.action: Read status here when the projected image is not visible. The drawn screen content is a placeholder.
components.basis: Part of the input and communication module on the right side. Its place in the module is assumed.

components.label: Local keypad
components.purpose: Local control of power, menus and basic adjustments without the remote.
components.action: Use with the LCD panel. Key count and legends are not modeled.
components.basis: Part of the input and communication module on the right side. Key layout is a stand-in.

components.label: Status lights
components.purpose: Show projector state at a glance. The user guide lists orange for ready and green for on.
components.action: Check before sending commands. Read the user guide for every colour and blink pattern.
components.basis: Listed on the communication panel. Count and place are assumed.

components.label: Side IR receiver
components.purpose: Receives the remote control from the input and communication side.
components.action: Point the remote toward this window when working at the connector side.
components.basis: Published as on the right side, inside the input and communication module.

components.label: HDMI 2.0 input
components.purpose: Digital video input on the Quad Combo input board.
components.action: Select the input from the source menu. Confirm the exact timing your source sends.
components.basis: The input is published. Its place on the board is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: DisplayPort 1.2 input
components.purpose: Digital video input on the Quad Combo input board.
components.action: Select the input from the source menu. Confirm the exact timing your source sends.
components.basis: The input is published. Its place on the board is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: HDBaseT input
components.purpose: Video over a category cable from an HDBaseT transmitter.
components.action: Connect Ethernet to this input or to the LAN port, not both.
components.basis: The input is published. Its place on the board is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: Quad SDI connectors
components.purpose: Four BNC connectors for 3G to 12G SDI on the Quad Combo input board.
components.action: Check the user guide for which connectors are inputs and which pass the signal through.
components.basis: Four SDI connectors are published. Their order and place are a schematic arrangement.

components.label: LAN port
components.purpose: 10/100 Base-T network port for control over IP and Art-Net.
components.action: Use for network control. A modeled port does not make a projector reachable.
components.basis: The port is published on the communication panel. Its place is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: DMX in and out
components.purpose: DMX 512 input, and an output to the next device in the chain.
components.action: Wire in to out through the chain and terminate the last device.
components.basis: Input and output are published. Connector style and place are a schematic arrangement.

components.label: Wired remote input
components.purpose: XLR input for controlling the projector with the remote on a cable.
components.action: Use when infrared is unreliable. Check the user guide for the cable required.
components.basis: An XLR wired-control input is published. Its place is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: RS232 port
components.purpose: Serial control on a Sub-D connector.
components.action: Use the protocol and settings in the Barco control documentation.
components.basis: The port is published. Its place is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: USB port
components.purpose: Firmware updates and log download.
components.action: Follow the user guide update procedure. Keep power stable during an update.
components.basis: The port is published. Its place is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: 3D sync in and out
components.purpose: BNC connectors that take and send a 3D synchronisation signal.
components.action: Used only in stereoscopic systems.
components.basis: Sync in and sync out are published. Their place is a schematic arrangement.

components.label: 12 V output
components.purpose: Low-voltage output rated 12 V at 1 A.
components.action: Stay inside the 1 A rating.
components.basis: The output is published. Connector style and place are a schematic arrangement.

components.label: Representative TLD+ lens
components.purpose: Shows where a lens sits. It stands in for the TLD+ family and is not a specific lens.
components.action: Identify the fitted lens from its barrel marking before any throw calculation.
components.basis: TLD+ lenses mount at the front. Barrel size and shape are generic.

frame.origin: foot contact plane under the centre of the published envelope

nominal.conflict: The specification sheet prints the same figures as 725 x 540 x 339 mm under the W x L x H heading.
nominal.includes: Not stated whether feet, handles or the lens holder are inside these figures. The body ships without a lens.

reported.note: The excerpt gives 223 mm with all feet retracted and no vertical shift. Reading it as lens-centre height is an interpretation.

dimensions.use: approximate inspection only; not measured fit

rig.context: No stand, rigging frame, flight case, cables or screen are included.
